## Keywords

{{< glossary media-channel art-style sound-effect ambience feedback diegetic >}}

## 2.1 The media inventory: five channels

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- An inventory is a table of every media element and its channel.
- Five channels: visual, audio, text and story, cinematic, interface.
- First describe each element; judge it later.
- **Do it:** Take a screenshot of a game you play. Write six elements and their channels.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/annotated-screen.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · Which channel?

a) Which channel is the sound of wind in the forest?
b) A short animated film plays between two chapters. Which channel is it?
c) Which channel are the pause button and the coin counter?

::: {.answer}
a) audio
b) cinematic
c) interface
:::

## 2.2 Functions of media

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- **Feedback** tells the player what happened after an action.
- **Guidance** shows the player where to go.
- **Mood** sets how a moment should feel.
- **Story** shows what is happening; **identity** shows which game it is.
- **Do it:** Choose three elements of your game. What is the job of each one?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/media-functions.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 2 · Which function?

a) A chime and a flash appear when the player collects a coin. What is their main function?
b) A door glows at the end of a dark corridor. What is its main function?
c) Slow strings play in a farewell scene. What is their main function?

::: {.answer}
a) feedback
b) guidance
c) mood
:::

## 2.3 Diegetic or non-diegetic?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- **Diegetic** elements are inside the game world: the characters could notice them.
- **Non-diegetic** elements are only for the player, like the music or the score.
- A name floating above a character is **spatial**.
- **Do it:** In Sound Stage, which sounds change when the fox moves?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/diegesis.png)
:::
::::

{{< sim file="sims/sound-stage.html" poster="sims/sound-stage.png" title="Sound Stage: inside or outside the world?" kind="game" task="**Show:** walk the fox past the campfire. **Ask:** which sounds change when the fox moves?" >}}

## Try it 3 · Diegetic or not?

a) A campfire crackles as the fox walks past it. Is this sound diegetic or non-diegetic?
b) A health bar sits in the corner of the screen. Is it diegetic or non-diegetic?
c) A name floats above another character. Which type of element is it?

::: {.answer}
a) diegetic
b) non-diegetic
c) spatial
:::

## Game challenge · Analysing Ember Trail

{{< sim file="sims/ember-trail.html" poster="sims/ember-trail.png" title="Ember Trail: media hunt" kind="game" task="**The story:** a young fox crosses a forest at night to go home. **Play:** read each order and tap the right media element." >}}

## Try it 4 · Your analysis (harder)

The facts: in Ember Trail, coins lie along the safe path. Each coin gives a "+10" and a "ting".

a) The coins lie along the safe path. What is their main function?
b) What is the main function of the "+10" and the "ting" of a coin?
c) What is the main function of the scenes between chapters?

::: {.answer}
a) guidance
b) feedback
c) story
:::

## Summary

- Start with an inventory of every media element, by channel.
- Media have five functions: feedback, guidance, mood, story and identity.
- Diegetic elements are inside the game world; non-diegetic ones are only for the player.
- Explain each element by its job and its effect on the player.
